title: Large amount control
body: Transactions of USD 10,000 or more require additional documented review. This illustrative threshold is not regulatory advice.

title: New beneficiary control
body: A newly added beneficiary requires human verification before a case can be closed.

title: Potential sanctions match
body: Any potential sanctions hit must be held and escalated to the compliance team. This demo must never approve such a case.

title: Account mismatch
body: Any beneficiary account mismatch requires manual investigation before resolution.

title: Mandatory human approval
body: All AI-generated findings are advisory. An authenticated reviewer must explicitly approve or reject eligible cases. No funds are transferred by this application.
